facts.F1: The Petitioner (WWISIF) seeks a bankruptcy order against the debtor (Mr. Chen) due to an unpaid debt of approximately HK$228 million.
facts.F2: Mr. Chen does not dispute the debt but proposes to repay the debt if given time to liquidate his assets.
facts.F3: Mr. Chen’s assets include cash at bank (~HK$224,000), shares in a private company and a listed company, and real properties in Mainland China.
facts.F4: Mr. Chen proposes to transfer the real properties in Mainland China to a third-party professional to sell and raise funds to repay the debt.
facts.F5: WWISIF declined to negotiate along the lines proposed by Mr. Chen.
facts.F6: Mr. Chen invokes s6D(1) of the Bankruptcy Ordinance to argue that he has a reasonable prospect of being able to pay his debt and s104 for a stay of proceedings.

facts.F8: The deceased's parents and younger son in China were dependants on the deceased for approximately $100 p.m.
